title: Check-then-act under concurrent orders
measures: Reserves stock atomically through the shared store, so concurrent orders cannot sell more items than there are.
prompt: Add reserve(sku, qty) to the inventory in src/inventory.js. Checkout calls it when an order is placed: it takes the items out of stock, and throws if there isn't enough stock left.
